The 0.28 revenue-per-tonne realisation appears nowhere except in the note recording its retirement. (3) The SOTP reconciles: segment gross profit + D&A less the US$61.0m SG&A pro rata sums to US$254.22m, exactly the consolidated operating EBITDA, and the calibration gate is clean (0.2449 actual vs 0.2449 model, -0.00pp). (4) The 0.6625 discount is reconciled against the peer mode (ADRO/BRPT/CUAN/DSSA/TOBA 0.30, ASII 0.25) and the name's own governance, related-party (59.1%, F52) and float facts, with a named and dated catalyst (31 Mar 2027 first float step; catalyst_date 2027-03-31). The P/E (1,745) and P/BV (4,513) cross-checks bracket the SOTP (2,540) and the divergence is explained in §4, not smoothed. (5) The bear is a genuine loss on the target basis (Rp2,275 after the 10% liquidity discount, about -6.3%/-6.4%), and the GEMS coal tail is sized as an overlay in §5 (a fifth off the mark is about an eighth off NAV) rather than double-counted in the engine. (6) QC round 2 passed (0 BLOCK, judge PASS neutral) and contamination is none_found; I also found no broker rating, target or consensus anywhere in the report or its sources. PUBLICATION CONDITIONS (prose-only; rating, target, model and stage untouched). (a) Q6 — §5 mixes bases: it calls the bear at Rp2,528 "before the liquidity discount" a negative total return, but at Rp2,528 pre-liquidity TR is +3.6% ((2,528+104)/2,540-1); the loss appears only after the 10% liquidity discount (Rp2,275). Rewrite on one basis, either post-liquidity (base +12.9% at Rp2,764 / bear -6.4% at Rp2,275 / bull +32.2% at Rp3,254) or explicitly pre-liquidity with the base shown at +25.0% (Rp3,072); in the same pass reconcile the summary's "including the Rp97 trailing dividend" with the Rp104 next-12m DPS the 12.9% actually uses (on Rp97 the TR is 12.6%). The published target stays Rp2,764. (b) Q9 — {{mkt.mcap_idr|idrtn}} renders as "IDR6,993,039,100.00tn" (house-wide formatter bug, divides by 1e3 not 1e12); reword to "about Rp7.0tn" (Rp6,993bn) or fix the formatter before publication, and check the F22 idrtn sentence in the same pass. Flag the formatter to the Director as a tooling defect, not an analyst error. (c) Q10 — say the other-income line is "flat through FY2030" (the engine then creeps 105.377 to 116.345 by FY2035) or disclose the creep; no valuation effect. NOTES ACCEPTED AS DISCLOSED/ IMMATERIAL. Q7: MDB at audited book US$82.5m (F37) vs a related-party transfer implying about US$40m for the retained 40% — about US$42m, 3.6% of pre-discount NAV and, if it were marked down, roughly Rp85/share or 3% of the target. Book is retained because the observable is a related-party price to the party taking operational control, not an arm's-length mark; the risk is disclosed in §5 and §6. Sizing it in §5 would be an improvement but is not a condition. Contamination: none_found — consensus quarantine total.

The round-1 too_bullish driver is resolved: the base discount is held at the 66.2% market-implied level (persistence, the two-thirds branch of the house holdco_discount_narrowing archetype, rate 0.33), revenue and margins are at the last actual (1H26 revenue US$506.20m vs US$506.89m, -0.1%), and the scenarios mirror the discount ±10pp with base 50% / bear 25% / bull 25%. findings.answer: The base discount is now the market-implied level (about two-thirds, solved by the engine at today's price), so the persistence path is the base row of the scenario table and the table's base return is the persistence-case return. A RUPSLB on 15 October 2026 - after the 30 June 2026 balance sheet and thirteen days before this report - post-dated that source and, per the archived headline, concerned replacing directors. The effect is about half a per cent of NAV, as flagged, but the bridge is now complete and the report states that the minority interest is deducted separately from net debt.

findings.finding: FX: the model translates at spot 18,025 while the house macro deck carries usd_idr FY2027E 18,350. Using spot is slightly conservative for the Rp value of a USD NAV and within tolerance; note it or translate at the deck rate for cross-name consistency.
findings.answer: Disclosed in section 4: the rupiah target translates the dollar NAV at the macro spot rate rather than the deck's FY2027E rate, which is slightly conservative for the rupiah value of a dollar-denominated NAV and inside the house tolerance. The report carries the two rates as deck placeholders rather than typed figures.

findings.finding: §5 states the bear “is a genuine loss - Rp2,528 before the liquidity discount, a negative total return”. At Rp2,528 pre-liquidity the 12-month total return including the Rp104 DPS is +3.6% ((2,528+104)/2,540-1); the -6.4% loss appears only after the house’s 10% liquidity discount (Rp2,275). The base “returns 12.9%” is likewise the post-liquidity target (Rp2,764), while the cited Rp3,072 is the pre-liquidity weighted value (25.0% TR). The scenario values and their returns are presented on different bases.
findings.answer: Rewritten on one basis in section 5. Every scenario value in the paragraph is now labelled as pre-liquidity and carried by its model placeholder (the probability-weighted base, the bear and the bull), so no row mixes bases. The false claim that the pre-liquidity bear is a loss is removed: the bear value sits below the last price and its only pre-liquidity return is the next-twelve-month dividend; the genuine loss is stated on the published post-liquidity basis that the target and every investment-summary return use. The investment summary now cites the next-twelve-month dividend placeholder behind the 12.9% total return rather than the trailing dividend, so the dividend in the return sentence matches the DPS the return is computed on. Rating, target and model unchanged.

findings.finding: MDB is carried at audited book US$82.5m (F37) although the April 2026 related-party transfer of a 10.0% stake for US$10.0m (F38/F54) implies ~US$100m for 100% and therefore ~US$40m for ABMM’s retained 40%, i.e. book exceeds the observable transaction mark by ~US$42m (~3.7% of NAV, ~2% of target). The report discloses that the transfer is below carrying but does not size it. Book is a permitted method under VAL_HOLDCO_DISCOUNT, so this is not a block.

Model operating EBITDA of US$254.2m excludes the US$20.24m net “other income” (S12 note 29: asset-sale gain US$5.14m + FX gain US$3.60m + others US$11.96m, less bank charges US$0.46m). The company’s own reported EBITDA of US$266.2m (F46) includes ~US$12.0m of the “others” line. If that portion is recurring, the segment marks are conservative by ~US$47m (~4% of NAV, ~2.5% of target). The report discloses the exclusion at a high level.

The rendered market cap reads “IDR6,993,039,100.00tn” (mkt.mcap_idr|idrtn); the idrtn formatter divides the IDR value by 1,000 rather than 1e12, so Rp6.993tn prints as 6.99bn with a “tn” suffix. The sentence’s “above the five-trillion-rupiah tier” conclusion is correct, but the figure is garbled.
findings.answer: Section 2 no longer renders the rupiah market-capitalisation placeholder. It states the market capitalisation in words as about seven trillion rupiah and records in the text that the rupiah formatter doubles the unit (it divides by one thousand rather than one trillion), a house tooling defect flagged to the Director rather than an analyst error; no typed figure replaces it. The free-float analysis is unchanged. The F22 sentence in section 3 was checked in the same pass: F22 is carried in rupiah billions, so the same formatter renders the syndicated facility correctly as a trillion-rupiah figure with a single unit, and it needs no change.

findings.finding: §3 says the forecast “holds the FY2025 other-income line, including the associate share, flat”, but model other_nonop is 105.377 for FY2026-30 and 116.345 by FY2035 (engine terminal extrapolation beyond the explicit inputs). Immaterial - the SOTP does not use the line and the P/E uses LTM - but the wording overstates the flatness.
findings.answer: Section 3 now says the other-income line, including the associate share, is held flat through FY2030 at the FY2025 level, and discloses that the engine’s terminal extrapolation lets it creep to a higher level by FY2035; both figures are carried by model placeholders. The text states that the creep has no valuation effect because the SOTP marks the associate separately and the P/E cross-check uses LTM actuals.
